# Model

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 1 — NFL GRID SETUP
# =============================================================================

build_nfl_grid <- function(pitch_length = 120.0, pitch_width = 53.3, n_cols = 120, n_rows = 54) {
  xs <- seq(0, pitch_length, length.out = n_cols)
  ys <- seq(0, pitch_width, length.out = n_rows)
  
  grid_x <- matrix(rep(xs, each = n_rows), nrow = n_rows, ncol = n_cols)
  grid_y <- matrix(rep(ys, times = n_cols), nrow = n_rows, ncol = n_cols)
  
  return(list(x = grid_x, y = grid_y))
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 2 — TRACKING DATA PARSER
# =============================================================================

extract_frame_data <- function(nfl_df, target_game, target_play, target_frame) {
  # Filter the dataset to the exact frame
  frame_data <- nfl_df %>%
    filter(game_id == target_game, play_id == target_play, frame_id == target_frame) %>%
    filter(!is.na(nfl_id)) 
  
  # Use dir_std for standardized velocity calculations
  frame_data <- frame_data %>%
    mutate(
      dir_rad = dir_std * pi / 180,
      vx = s * sin(dir_rad),
      vy = s * cos(dir_rad)
    )
  
  # Split into offense and defense lists
  offense_df <- frame_data %>% filter(player_side == "offense")
  defense_df <- frame_data %>% filter(player_side == "defense")
  
  # Helper to convert dataframe rows into the expected list format (Updated to x_std, y_std)
  to_player_list <- function(df) {
    lapply(1:nrow(df), function(i) {
      list(
        id = df$nfl_id[i],
        team = df$player_side[i],
        x = df$x_std[i],
        y = df$y_std[i],
        vx = df$vx[i],
        vy = df$vy[i]
      )
    })
  }
  
  return(list(
    attacking_players = to_player_list(offense_df),
    defending_players = to_player_list(defense_df),
    target_x = frame_data$ball_land_x_std[1],
    target_y = frame_data$ball_land_y_std[1]
  ))
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 3 — KINEMATICS & BALL FLIGHT (NFL TUNED)
# =============================================================================

player_time_to_intercept <- function(player, target_x, target_y, vmax = 11.0, acceleration = 8.0) {
  p0 <- c(player$x, player$y)
  v0_vec <- c(player$vx, player$vy)
  
  dx <- target_x - p0[1]
  dy <- target_y - p0[2]
  
  distances <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
  distances[distances == 0 | is.na(distances)] <- 1e-8
  
  unit_x <- dx / distances
  unit_y <- dy / distances
  
  v0_proj <- v0_vec[1] * unit_x + v0_vec[2] * unit_y
  v0_proj <- pmin(v0_proj, vmax)
  
  t_acc <- (vmax - v0_proj) / acceleration
  d_acc <- (v0_proj * t_acc) + (0.5 * acceleration * (t_acc^2))
  
  tti <- array(0, dim = dim(distances))
  if (is.null(dim(distances))) tti <- numeric(length(distances))
  
  acc_phase_mask <- d_acc >= distances
  acc_phase_mask[is.na(acc_phase_mask)] <- FALSE # Safeguard against NA
  
  cruise_phase_mask <- !acc_phase_mask
  cruise_phase_mask[is.na(cruise_phase_mask)] <- FALSE # Safeguard against NA
  
  sqrt_term <- pmax(v0_proj^2 + 2 * acceleration * distances, 0)
  
  if (any(acc_phase_mask, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    tti[acc_phase_mask] <- (-v0_proj[acc_phase_mask] + sqrt(sqrt_term[acc_phase_mask])) / acceleration
  }
  if (any(cruise_phase_mask, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    d_cruise <- distances[cruise_phase_mask] - d_acc[cruise_phase_mask]
    tti[cruise_phase_mask] <- t_acc[cruise_phase_mask] + (d_cruise / vmax)
  }
  return(tti)
}

estimate_nfl_pass_bounds <- function(distances) {
  # Approximations for thrown footballs in yards
  # Fast bullet pass ~ 30 yds/sec, high lob ~ 15 yds/sec
  min_time <- distances / 30.0 
  max_time <- distances / 15.0
  return(list(min = pmax(min_time, 0.0), max = pmax(max_time, 0.0)))
}

football_travel_time <- function(qb_x, qb_y, target_x, target_y, attacking_players) {
  dx <- target_x - qb_x
  dy <- target_y - qb_y
  distances <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
  
  bounds <- estimate_nfl_pass_bounds(distances)
  
  tti_shape <- dim(target_x)
  if (is.null(tti_shape)) nearest_attacker_tti <- rep(Inf, length(target_x))
  else nearest_attacker_tti <- array(Inf, dim = tti_shape)
  
  for (player in attacking_players) {
    # Skip if player is the QB (assumed to be the one throwing)
    if (abs(player$x - qb_x) < 0.1 && abs(player$y - qb_y) < 0.1) next
    
    player_tti <- player_time_to_intercept(player, target_x, target_y)
    nearest_attacker_tti <- pmin(nearest_attacker_tti, player_tti)
  }
  
  selected_ball_time <- pmin(pmax(nearest_attacker_tti, bounds$min), bounds$max)
  return(selected_ball_time)
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 4 — ARRIVAL PROBABILITY & INTEGRATION
# =============================================================================

arrival_probability <- function(t, tti, tti_sigma = 0.54) {
  exponent <- -pi / sqrt(3.0) / tti_sigma * (t - tti)
  exponent <- pmin(pmax(exponent, -50), 50)
  return(1.0 / (1.0 + exp(exponent)))
}

control_rate <- function(t, tti, lambda_j = 3.99, tti_sigma = 0.54) {
  P <- arrival_probability(t, tti, tti_sigma)
  return(P * lambda_j)
}

nfl_dynamic_pitch_control <- function(attacking_players, defending_players, qb_pos, grid_x, grid_y,
                                      dt = 0.05, max_time = 8.0, vmax = 11.0, acceleration = 8.0,
                                      lambda_att = 3.99, kappa = 1.72, tti_sigma = 0.54) {
  
  lambda_def <- lambda_att * kappa
  
  TTI_att <- lapply(attacking_players, function(p) player_time_to_intercept(p, grid_x, grid_y, vmax, acceleration))
  TTI_def <- lapply(defending_players, function(p) player_time_to_intercept(p, grid_x, grid_y, vmax, acceleration))
  
  T_ball <- football_travel_time(qb_pos$x, qb_pos$y, grid_x, grid_y, attacking_players)
  
  PPCF_att <- array(0.0, dim = dim(grid_x))
  PPCF_def <- array(0.0, dim = dim(grid_x))
  PPCF_tot <- array(0.0, dim = dim(grid_x))
  
  integration_times <- seq(0.0, max_time, by = dt)
  
  for (t in integration_times) {
    active <- t >= T_ball
    if (!any(active)) next
    
    calc_mask <- active & (PPCF_tot < 0.999)
    if (!any(calc_mask)) next
    
    rate_att_cells <- lapply(TTI_att, function(tti_mat) control_rate(t, tti_mat[calc_mask], lambda_att, tti_sigma))
    rate_def_cells <- lapply(TTI_def, function(tti_mat) control_rate(t, tti_mat[calc_mask], lambda_def, tti_sigma))
    
    rate_att <- Reduce("+", rate_att_cells)
    rate_def <- Reduce("+", rate_def_cells)
    
    uncontrolled_prob <- 1.0 - PPCF_tot[calc_mask]
    
    dPPCF_att <- uncontrolled_prob * rate_att * dt
    dPPCF_def <- uncontrolled_prob * rate_def * dt
    
    PPCF_att[calc_mask] <- PPCF_att[calc_mask] + dPPCF_att
    PPCF_def[calc_mask] <- PPCF_def[calc_mask] + dPPCF_def
    PPCF_tot[calc_mask] <- PPCF_tot[calc_mask] + dPPCF_att + dPPCF_def
  }
  
  behind_qb_mask <- grid_x < qb_pos$x
  PPCF_att[behind_qb_mask] <- 0.0
  
  return(list(PPCF_att = PPCF_att, PPCF_def = PPCF_def))
}

```

# Processing

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(tidyr)
library(future)
library(furrr)

# =============================================================================
# 1. SETUP PARALLEL PLAN
# =============================================================================
# Use multisession across 5 available local cores (leaving some free for your OS, other ops)
plan(multisession, workers = 8)

# Create a temporary directory to store chunked results on disk
temp_dir <- "play_results_temp"
if (!dir.exists(temp_dir)) dir.create(temp_dir)

# =============================================================================
# 2. RESTRUCTURED PROCESSING FUNCTION (Accepts individual play data)
# =============================================================================
process_single_play <- function(play_data, output_dir, target_wr_id = NULL) {
  
  # Extract IDs
  current_game_id <- play_data$game_id[1]
  current_play_id <- play_data$play_id[1]
  
  play_processed <- play_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(nfl_id), phase == "pre_pass") %>%
    mutate(
      player_side = tolower(player_side), 
      dir_rad = dir_std * pi / 180, 
      vx = s * sin(dir_rad),
      vy = s * cos(dir_rad)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_std) & !is.na(y_std) & !is.na(vx) & !is.na(vy))
  
  if (nrow(play_processed) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  frames <- sort(unique(play_processed$frame_id))
  grids <- build_nfl_grid(n_cols = 120, n_rows = 54)
  
  xs <- seq(0, 120.0, length.out = 120)
  ys <- seq(0, 53.3, length.out = 54)
  grid_df_base <- expand.grid(y = ys, x = xs) 
  
  all_frames_ppcf <- list()
  
  for (f in frames) {
    frame_data <- play_processed %>% filter(frame_id == f)
    
    offense_df <- frame_data %>% filter(player_side == "offense")
    defense_df <- frame_data %>% filter(player_side == "defense")
    
    to_player_list <- function(df) {
      if(nrow(df) == 0) return(list())
      lapply(1:nrow(df), function(i) {
        list(id = df$nfl_id[i], x = df$x_std[i], y = df$y_std[i], vx = df$vx[i], vy = df$vy[i])
      })
    }
    
    qb_row <- offense_df %>% filter(tolower(player_position) == "qb") %>% slice(1)
    if(nrow(qb_row) == 0) qb_row <- offense_df %>% slice(1) 
    
    if (nrow(qb_row) > 0) {
      qb_pos <- list(x = qb_row$x_std, y = qb_row$y_std)
      offense_df <- offense_df %>% filter(nfl_id != qb_row$nfl_id)
    } else {
      qb_pos <- list(x = 60, y = 26.6)
    }
    
    if (!is.null(target_wr_id)) {
      target_offense_df <- offense_df %>% filter(nfl_id == target_wr_id)
    } else {
      target_offense_df <- offense_df
    }
    
    # Corrected line: Use target_offense_df instead of offense_df
    attacking_players <- to_player_list(target_offense_df)
    defending_players <- to_player_list(defense_df)
    
    # --- FIX 1: Skip frame if one side is entirely missing ---
    if (length(attacking_players) == 0 || length(defending_players) == 0) {
      next 
    }
    
    # --- FIX 2: Wrap the calculation in tryCatch to prevent hard crashes ---
    results <- tryCatch({
      nfl_dynamic_pitch_control(
        attacking_players = attacking_players,
        defending_players = defending_players,
        qb_pos = qb_pos,
        grid_x = grids$x,
        grid_y = grids$y
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      # If the math fails, return NULL and silently continue
      return(NULL) 
    })
    
    # Skip to the next frame if an error occurred
    if (is.null(results)) next
    
    frame_surface <- grid_df_base
    frame_surface$frame_id <- f
    frame_surface$ppcf_att <- as.vector(results$PPCF_att) 
    
    all_frames_ppcf[[as.character(f)]] <- frame_surface
  }
  
  if (length(all_frames_ppcf) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  surface_data <- bind_rows(all_frames_ppcf)
  
  # Apply your filtering logic (maximum frame_id per play)
  surface_data <- surface_data %>%
    mutate(
      game_id = current_game_id,
      play_id = current_play_id
    )
  
  # Write directly to disk as a task completes to free up RAM
  file_name <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("play_", current_game_id, "_", current_play_id, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(surface_data, file_name)
  
  return(file_name)
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. EXECUTE PARALLEL MAPPING
# =============================================================================
# Define the specific WR's nfl_id before running
WR_id_find <- full_df %>%
  filter(player_name == 'Mike Evans') %>% 
  select(nfl_id, player_name) %>% 
  distinct()
target_receiver_id <- 41233  # Replace with the actual nfl_id

message("Optimizing upstream data...")

optimized_df <- full_df %>%
  # 1. Drop irrelevant phases and missing data immediately
  filter(phase == "pre_pass", !is.na(nfl_id)) %>%
  
  # 2. Keep ONLY plays where your target WR is on the field
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
  filter(any(nfl_id == target_receiver_id)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # 3. Keep ONLY the Target WR, the QB, and the Defense
  filter(
    tolower(player_side) == "defense" | 
    nfl_id == target_receiver_id | 
    tolower(player_position) == "qb"
  )

# Split the drastically reduced dataset
plays_list <- optimized_df %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
  group_split()

message(sprintf("Processing %d relevant plays across %d parallel workers...", length(plays_list), num_workers))

# Clear old cached files before starting a new run
temp_dir <- "play_results_temp"
if (dir.exists(temp_dir)) unlink(temp_dir, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(temp_dir)

# Run in parallel with a progress bar (.progress = TRUE)
saved_files <- future_map_chr(
  plays_list, 
  ~ process_single_play(.x, temp_dir, target_wr_id = target_receiver_id),
  .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
  .progress = TRUE
)

# Clean up parallel plan and reset to sequential
plan(sequential)

# =============================================================================
# 4. LOAD FROM DISK AND COMBINE
# =============================================================================
message("Loading chunked files from disk and combining...")

saved_files <- saved_files[!is.na(saved_files)]

all_rds_files <- list.files(temp_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
final_surface_data <- bind_rows(lapply(all_rds_files, readRDS))

# Write final consolidated CSV
write.csv(final_surface_data, "Mike_Evans_field_control_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

message("Done! Final dataset saved to 'field_control_data.csv'.")
```

# Plot Field Control

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# PLOT
# =============================================================================

plot_nfl_pitch_control_anim <- function(play_results) {
  surface_data <- play_results$surface_data
  
  player_data <- play_results$player_data %>%
    mutate(player_side = tolower(player_side)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_std) & !is.na(y_std) & !is.na(vx) & !is.na(vy))
  
  ymin <- 0; ymax <- 53.3
  xmin <- 0; xmax <- 120
  
  field_plot <- ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#1e7a3a") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 10, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#135c29") +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 110, xmax = 120, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = "#135c29") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 5), color = "white", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 10), color = "white", linewidth = 1)
  
  animated_plot <- field_plot +
    geom_tile(
      data = surface_data, 
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = ppcf_att), 
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#1e40af", mid = "white", high = "#b91c1c", 
      midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1), 
      name = "Offense\nControl Prob"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = player_data,
      aes(
        x = x_std, y = y_std, 
        xend = x_std + vx * 0.5, yend = y_std + vy * 0.5,
        color = player_side
      ),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")), 
      linewidth = 0.8 
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = player_data, 
      aes(x = x_std, y = y_std), 
      size = 4, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = player_data, 
      aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, color = player_side), 
      size = 2.8 
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("offense" = "#facc15", "defense" = "#3b82f6"),
      name = "Team"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(title = 'Frame: {current_frame}') +
    transition_manual(frame_id)
  
  return(animated_plot)
}

# 1. Identify first play
target_game <- final_surface_data$game_id[1]
target_play <- final_surface_data$play_id[1]

# 2. Filter surface data for this play
anim_surface_data <- final_surface_data %>%
  filter(game_id == target_game, play_id == target_play)

# 3. Filter tracking dots to ONLY Mike Evans, QB, and Defense across valid pre_pass frames
anim_player_data <- full_df %>%
  filter(
    game_id == target_game, 
    play_id == target_play,
    frame_id %in% unique(anim_surface_data$frame_id),
    (nfl_id == target_receiver_id | tolower(player_position) == "qb" | tolower(player_side) == "defense")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_rad = dir_std * pi / 180,
    vx = s * sin(dir_rad),
    vy = s * cos(dir_rad)
  )

# 4. Package and render
play_results <- list(
  surface_data = anim_surface_data,
  player_data = anim_player_data
)

anim <- plot_nfl_pitch_control_anim(play_results)
animate(
  anim, 
  nframes = length(unique(play_results$surface_data$frame_id)), 
  fps = 10, 
  width = 800, 
  height = 400
)
```

# Incorporate Coverage Efficiency
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)

# =============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA & MODELS
# =============================================================================
# Raw Tracking Data
full_df <- read_csv("~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/full_data.csv")

# Single WR Field Control Data (Multi-Frame)
field_control <- read_csv("~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/Mike_Evans_field_control_data.csv")

# GAM Field Value Model
field_value <- readRDS("~/Documents/Football_R/CMSAC--Field Value/gam_field_value_model.rds")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. PREPARE GRID & PLAY METADATA
# =============================================================================
play_data <- full_df %>% 
  select(game_id, play_id, frame_id, ball_land_y_std, expected_points, los_x_std, dropback_distance) %>% 
  distinct()

feed_model <- field_control %>% 
  left_join(play_data, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "frame_id")) %>% 
  mutate(pass_depth = x - los_x_std) %>% 
  # Eliminate impossible passes beyond the back of the endzone (110 yards)
  filter((los_x_std + pass_depth) <= 110)

# =============================================================================
# 3. CHUNKED MODEL PREDICTIONS
# =============================================================================
# Select ONLY the variables required by the GAM model formula
gam_vars <- intersect(all.vars(formula(field_value)), names(feed_model))
predict_data <- feed_model %>% select(all_of(gam_vars))

# Split dataset into ordered chunks
chunk_size <- 500000 
chunks_list <- split(predict_data, (seq_len(nrow(predict_data)) - 1) %/% chunk_size)

# Run Parallel Predictions
plan(multisession, workers = 8)

message(sprintf("Running parallel GAM predictions across %d workers...", max(1, availableCores() - 1)))

predictions <- future_map(
  chunks_list,
  ~ predict(field_value, newdata = .x, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE),
  .options = furrr_options(globals = c("field_value"), seed = TRUE),
  .progress = TRUE
)

plan(sequential) # Reset parallel plan

# =============================================================================
# 4. COMPUTE GRID-LEVEL EFFICIENCY
# =============================================================================
feed_model$pred_post_epa <- unlist(predictions)
feed_model$epa <- feed_model$pred_post_epa - feed_model$expected_points

# Raw non-linear efficiency metric
raw_eff <- (sign(feed_model$epa) * sqrt(abs(feed_model$epa))) * (feed_model$ppcf_att^2)

# Scale efficiency and zero-out values behind the QB dropback position
all_grid <- feed_model %>% 
  mutate(
    efficiency = as.numeric(scale(raw_eff)),
    efficiency = ifelse((pass_depth - dropback_distance) <= 0, 0, efficiency)
  )

# =============================================================================
# 5. AGGREGATE EFFICIENCY ACROSS FRAMES
# =============================================================================

# (A) Frame-by-Frame Efficiency (Tracks route development over time)
frame_efficiency <- all_grid %>% 
  group_by(game_id, play_id, frame_id) %>% 
  summarize(
    total_wr_control = sum(ppcf_att, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_wr_control  = mean(ppcf_att, na.rm = TRUE),
    frame_efficiency = mean(efficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    pass_depth       = first(pass_depth),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# (B) Play-Level Summary (Aggregates performance across all pre-pass frames)
play_efficiency <- frame_efficiency %>% 
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_play_efficiency = mean(frame_efficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_frame_efficiency = max(frame_efficiency, na.rm = TRUE),
    final_frame_efficiency = last(frame_efficiency),
    total_frames_analyzed = n_distinct(frame_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =============================================================================
# 6. SAVE OUTPUTS
# =============================================================================
write_csv(all_grid, "Mike_Evans_grid_coverage_efficiency.csv")
write_csv(frame_efficiency, "Mike_Evans_frame_coverage_efficiency.csv")
write_csv(play_efficiency, "Mike_Evans_play_coverage_efficiency.csv")

message("Processing complete! Frame and play efficiency datasets exported.")
```
